executive_summary: Scottie Scheffler presents exceptional value at +749 with an 11.8% model win probability and field-leading +2.56 SG Total, making him a clear favorite despite recent inconsistency. Rory McIlroy's best-in-field +0.112 course fit adjustment combined with his recent win and 6.5% model probability at +1431 odds creates compelling value for bettors. Among longshots, Si Woo Kim at +5041 stands out with elite ball-striking (+0.82 SG Approach, 5th in field) and a 21.4% top-10 probability on a course where precision matters.

insights.title: Scheffler Massive Value Despite Inconsistency
insights.insight: Model gives Scheffler 11.8% win probability at +749 odds, creating a massive 11.7% edge with field-leading +2.56 SG Total and strong +0.074 course fit.

insights.title: McIlroy's Course Fit Advantage
insights.insight: McIlroy shows best-in-field +0.112 course fit adjustment and recent win form, with model seeing 6.5% win probability at generous +1431 odds.

insights.title: DeChambeau Bomber's Paradise Setup
insights.insight: With Augusta favoring bombers at 'very_high' level, DeChambeau's +0.098 course fit and 4.8% model win probability offers value at +1984 odds.

insights.title: Si Woo Kim Elite Ball-Striking Value
insights.insight: Kim ranks 5th in field in SG Approach (+0.82) with 21.4% top-10 probability, offering tremendous longshot value at +5041 odds.

insights.title: Morikawa Approach Play Discount
insights.insight: Field's best approach player (+0.95 SG) available at +4766 odds, perfect for Augusta's demanding second shot requirements.

insights.title: Fleetwood Negative Course Fit Warning
insights.insight: Despite strong +1.80 SG Total, Fleetwood's -0.020 course fit adjustment suggests his +2428 odds may be appropriately priced.

insights.title: Rahm Defending Champion Value
insights.insight: 2023 winner shows +2.26 SG Total (2nd in field) with 7.3% model win probability creating 7.2% edge at +1270 odds.

insights.title: Spieth Course History Premium
insights.insight: Three-time major winner gets +0.261 strokes course history boost with 20.3% top-10 probability at attractive +5410 longshot odds.
